user.description:
Enter the API hostname, application ID and API key for The Things Network HA-Alt.

[Read the instructions]({instructions_url}) on how to register your application and create an API key.
user.title: Connect to The Things Network HA-Alt

device_names_forbidden.description:
The API key for `{app_id}` does not have the **View devices in application** right on The Things Network, so device names cannot be synced. Existing device names in Home Assistant were kept.

Grant **View devices in application** on the API key in the TTN console, then reload the integration.
device_names_forbidden.title: API key cannot read TTN device names
